title: Multilinguality at the Edge: Developing Language Models for the Global South

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing reported language coverage across 232 surveyed research papers to quantify the lack of multilingual support in edge language models, revealing that edge-only NLP research is overwhelmingly monolingual.

Correlating country-level linguistic diversity with internet penetration rates and World Bank income groups to highlight systemic digital infrastructure and hardware disparities affecting communities in the Global South.
